displayPolicy: Never present aged research as an active trading signal. During refresh, keep the latest candidate visible as display-only and block new buy triggers until a fresh generation arrives.
stockSessionRule: Stock entry eligibility can close with the market; the site and monitoring health remain independently visible.

executionWakeBridge.note: This monitor detects triggers without an LLM and publishes them. It cannot itself wake Claude or place Robinhood orders. A Claude run or another authorized execution bridge is still required to act.

watchlist.armingRule: After a confirmed Robinhood buy, the execution agent must add the saved stop/target plan to docs/data/execution-watchlist.json. If it cannot arm this watchlist, do not treat fractional synthetic protection as active.

buyCompetition.rule: A/ELITE live stock triggers go first. If no A survives the live broker guards, B/BEST_ACCEPTABLE may be executed at its reduced encoded size. Failed candidates fall through to the next eligible candidate in the same run. Never force a trade when all hard guards fail.

triggerDefinitions.BUY_TRIGGER: Qualified fresh entry zone reached; live broker checks still required.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_1_STOP: Stop/invalidation reached — verify position and sell protected quantity.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_2_TARGET1: Target 1 reached — execute validated first scale-out.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_3_TARGET2: Target 2 reached — execute validated exit/runner decision.

creditPolicy: Alpaca/GitHub monitor prices. Claude should read the small dispatch packet first and avoid market/broker work when no action is needed.
